work.description: Brief CXIX (printed numeral garbled POS GXIK) providing Raphael Barissich OFM Obs. to the titular see of Azotus with consecration faculties; address 18420–18422, protocol 18425, Datum 18564–18569. LF18444–18445 are the continuation of the preceding letter's note 2 (not this act's text, not furniture); LF18446–18452 are this act's provenance citation (note 3), a signature-zone mark and the page-135 running title; LF18516 is page number 117. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF18425. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
